name: Acceptance suite-2 test 44 (boundary) - same key in DIFFERENT objects is legal
note: IAM-901 negative control: the SAME key name ("Action", "Sid", "Effect", "Resource") appearing once in each of two distinct statement objects is valid JSON and a normal policy - it must NOT be flagged DUPLICATE_JSON_KEY. Only a repeat WITHIN ONE object is a collision. Analysis proceeds normally and produces the DATA-READ / wildcard findings the policy warrants.
